description: This Python script demonstrates using the Perplexity API as a drop-in replacement for OpenAI, implementing a chat bot with speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and language model services, integrated into a pipeline with event handling for client connections.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Represents the context for the language model, including initial messages.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Handles aggregation of LLM context and user parameters.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the processing pipeline for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline and its parameters for execution.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution of the pipeline, including signal handling.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot pipeline with event handlers.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and starts the pipeline.
